each-ai-conversation-starts-fresh.header: Each AI conversation starts fresh: Mollick's forgetful coworker
each-ai-conversation-starts-fresh.description: Ethan Mollick advises treating AI "like an infinitely patient new coworker who forgets everything you tell them each new conversation" [1]. Claude Code sessions each begin "with a fresh context window" and only written files carry knowledge across [2]. "Amnesiac" is the Episode's word, not Mollick's.

three-mornings.title: Three mornings
three-mornings.script: So the next morning you open a new conversation, and the model knows nothing of yesterday. In our picture the pilot greets you with "Nice to meet you", you explain how to take the sediment sample step by step, and the robot waits on deck while you talk. The morning after, it is the same greeting and the same explanation, and by the third morning you could recite it in your sleep.

the-hook.title: The hook
the-hook.script: That is what working with AI feels like today, because every conversation starts from zero on how you work. You've explained this to the AI a hundred times. It has heard it once.

what-would-you-do.title: What would you do
what-would-you-do.script: So here is my question, and I would like your honest answer: if you worked with this model for a whole season, what would you do about it? If you're with me in a workshop, type it into the chat now. If you're watching the recording, pause here and answer out loud. I'll come back to it.
